items.title: IRAF: Interference-Resilient Adaptive Fusion for Noise-Robust End-to-End Full-Duplex Spoken Dialogue Systems
items.summary_en: Full-duplex spoken dialogue models allow voice agents to listen and speak concurrently, enabling natural interaction with real-time overlap. However, end-to-end dual-channel models that jointly encode user and agent streams may degrade in realistic acoustic environments: interfering speakers leaking into the user microphone can be encoded as part of the user query, corrupting the LLM's conditioning and causing unstab
items.summary_zh: IRAF 提出一种抗干扰自适应融合机制，解决端到端全双工对话模型在真实声学环境下的退化问题：干扰说话人声音漏入用户麦克风会被编码进用户query，污染 LLM 条件导致输出不稳。对座舱场景直接对口——车内乘客交谈、媒体声正是最典型的干扰源，其双通道融合与抗干扰思路可借鉴到流式 KV 注入的前端处理中。

items.title: BayLing-Duplex: Native Full-Duplex Speech Dialogue with a Single Autoregressive LLM
items.summary_en: Real-time, full-duplex speech interaction is a key feature of next-generation spoken chatbots, allowing the model to listen and speak at the same time and to handle natural phenomena such as overlap, hesitation, and barge-in. Existing speech language models (SpeechLMs) such as LLaMA-Omni and GLM-4-Voice are still turn-based and rely on an external Voice Activity Detection (VAD) module to mark the end of the user's tu
items.summary_zh: BayLing-Duplex 用单个自回归 LLM 实现原生全双工语音对话，摆脱 LLaMA-Omni、GLM-4-Voice 等轮次式方案对外部 VAD 判断用户话轮结束的依赖，原生处理重叠、犹豫与 barge-in。单模型架构与站内"流式进 KV、边说边听"的 harness 设计高度同构，是验证单模型路线可行性与去 VAD 化的重要参照。

items.title: Decoupling Conversational Dynamics in Full-Duplex Spoken Models through Reinforcement Learning
items.summary_en: Recent full-duplex spoken dialogue models have demonstrated compelling progress toward human-like interaction, enabling agents to respond with low latency, produce backchannels, and handle user barge-ins. Yet these improvements in conversational dynamics often come with weaker reasoning and instruction-following abilities, revealing a potential tension between interactive dynamics and intelligence capability. In this
items.summary_zh: DuplexPO 只在接话、附和和打断附近的小窗口用强化学习优化对话时序，并以 KL 约束保留回答能力；FDB-v3 报告 0.24 秒接话延迟和 100% yield。StreamingModelHarness 可借其分项奖励训练判停与让权控制器，但不能把原生双工模型指标外推到判停后生成和外挂 TTS。

items.title: Multi-Faceted Interactivity Alignment in Full-Duplex Speech Models
items.summary_en: Full-duplex spoken dialogue models can listen and speak simultaneously, making them a promising architecture for natural conversation. However, current models are trained solely with supervised learning through token-level likelihood maximization, which does not directly optimize interaction-level behaviors, causing interactivity issues such as excessive silence and ill-timed turn-taking. Recent work has applied rein
items.summary_zh: 该工作用 GRPO 分别优化原生双流模型的停顿、接话、附和和打断，并加入 LLM 语义奖励避免只追求低延迟而损伤内容。四轴事件定义适合改造成 StreamingModelHarness 的 endpoint、打断取消和 TTS 停声回归，但当前 Harness 并非统一时间轴的模型级全双工。

items.title: Chain-of-Thought Reasoning in Streaming Full-Duplex End-to-End Spoken Dialogue Systems
items.summary_en: Most end-to-end (E2E) spoken dialogue systems (SDS) rely on voice activity detection (VAD) for turn-taking, but VAD fails to distinguish between pauses and turn completions. Duplex SDS models address this by predicting output continuously, including silence tokens, thus removing the need for explicit VAD. However, they often have complex dual-channel architecture and lag behind cascaded models in semantic reasoning.
items.summary_zh: SCoT 在固定语音块前预测局部转写或文本响应，显著改善块级时分复用 SpeechLM 的语义，但 1 秒块会换来明显质量下降，推理还需候选重排。Harness 可借鉴 endpoint 前的局部转写与可撤销规划，不能把它描述成晚注入工具或外挂 TTS 已获得端到端全双工。

items.title: Chronological Thinking in Full-Duplex Spoken Dialogue Language Models
items.summary_en: Recent advances in spoken dialogue language models (SDLMs) reflect growing interest in shifting from turn-based to full-duplex systems, where the models continuously perceive user speech streams while generating responses. This simultaneous listening and speaking design enables real-time interaction and the agent can handle dynamic conversational behaviors like user barge-in. However, during the listening phase, exis
items.summary_zh: CT-Duplex 在助手静音区生成可抢占的实体、意图、动作、知识和逻辑节点，提升推理型对话与 barge-in 成功率，但事实问答增益很小且轮次启动延迟由 0.45 升至 0.68 秒。Harness 可在流式输入期维护可撤销草稿，回答仍应在 endpoint 与工具注入后生成。

items.title: A Reliability Assessment of LALM Audio Judges for Full-Duplex Voice Agents
items.summary_en: We report the empirical reliability of Gemini models as audio judges that score full-duplex agent conversations directly from the raw stereo waveform, tested across three models in the Gemini family: 2.5 Flash, 3.5 Flash, and 3.1 Pro. Our primary evidence base uses Gemini 2.5 Flash as the ground-truth model, validated against three calibrated human raters on 209 stereo sessions, scored on 8 production dimensions: 152
items.summary_zh: 该研究让 Gemini 直接读取完整双声道 WAV 做八维评分，发现口音和清晰度等部分维度可辅助人工，但整体保真度相关性接近零，若干 DSP 缺陷也会漏检。它适合做 StreamingModelHarness 的第四评分者，不验证流式判停、晚注入工具或原生全双工。

items.title: Phoenix-VAD: Streaming Semantic Endpoint Detection for Full-Duplex Speech Interaction
items.summary_en: Spoken dialogue models have significantly advanced intelligent human-computer interaction, yet they lack a plug-and-play full-duplex prediction module for semantic endpoint detection, hindering seamless audio interactions. In this paper, we introduce Phoenix-VAD, an LLM-based model that enables streaming semantic endpoint detection. Specifically, Phoenix-VAD leverages the semantic comprehension capability of the LLM
items.summary_zh: Phoenix-VAD 是一个基于 LLM 的流式语义端点检测模型，为全双工语音交互提供即插即用的“用户是否说完”判定模块。对本站的座舱助手直接有用：harness 里边说边听时最痛的难点就是语义级 endpoint/抢话判定，可以借鉴其把 LLM 语义理解能力用于流式 VAD 的思路，替代纯声学 VAD。

items.title: TurnGuide: Enhancing Meaningful Full Duplex Spoken Interactions via Dynamic Turn-Level Text-Speech Interleaving
items.summary_en: Full-Duplex Speech Language Models (FD-SLMs) are specialized foundation models designed to enable natural, real-time spoken interactions by modeling complex conversational turn-taking such as interruptions, backchannels, and overlapping speech. End-to-end (e2e) FD-SLMs leverage real-world double-channel conversational data to capture nuanced two-speaker dialogue patterns for human-like interactions, but their convers
items.summary_zh: TurnGuide 按自然停顿切分助手话轮，并在每个语音块前插入短文本块，Fisher 语义总分由基线约 5.6–5.9 提升到最高 7.79。公开脚本仍先读取完整 WAV，0.69 秒也只是理论首块延迟；Harness 只能借鉴 endpoint 后的短段规划。

items.title: DuplexChat: Constructing Speaker-Separated Full-Duplex Dialogue Speech at Scale for Spoken Dialogue Language Modeling
items.summary_en: Full-duplex spoken dialogue models are trained on conversational speech in which each speaker is represented as a separate stream, but existing large-scale public speech corpora are mostly monaural, making them unsuited for SDLM training. We present DuplexChat, an open-source corpus for full-duplex spoken dialogue models, and DuplexChat-Pipe, a pipeline for constructing speaker-separated full-duplex dialogue speech f
items.summary_zh: DuplexChat-Pipe 从播客筛选并分离出约 41.5 万小时英日双通道对话，保留 overlap、backchannel 和快速换轮；公开资源只是 792MB URL/时间戳清单，不含音频。它更适合训练 Harness 的判停与重叠检测，且使用前必须审计源播客版权和分离伪影。

items.title: Integrating Facial Generation into Full-Duplex Spoken Dialogue Systems
items.summary_en: Full-duplex spoken dialogue models, such as Moshi, enable natural, low-latency voice conversations. However, they remain limited to the audio modality, lacking the facial expressions that are integral to human communication. We present Moshi-Face, the first full-duplex dialogue model that jointly processes the user's audio and facial input while simultaneously generating speech and facial motion. We first construct a
items.summary_zh: Moshi-Face 在 Moshi 旁加入 12.5Hz 的双向 3D 人脸 token 流，联合接收用户声音/面部并生成助手语音/面部，但 UTMOS 从原始 Moshi 的 3.08 降至 1.75。其 face codec 仍非因果且无代码权重；当前判停后生成、外挂 TTS 的 Harness 最多借鉴头像方向，不能复现模型级联合生成。

items.title: DuplexSLA: A Full-Duplex Spoken Language Model with Synchronized Speech, Language, and Action
items.summary_en: Recent advances in spoken dialogue language models have shifted from turn-based to full-duplex designs, where the model continuously listens to the user while generating responses. However, existing duplex backbones still lack a native channel for in-conversation planning and tool calling, leaving real-time agentic behaviour either tied to turn boundaries or relegated to an external cascade. We propose DuplexSLA, a n
items.summary_zh: DuplexSLA 提出语音、语言、动作三者同步的全双工口语模型，在双工主干内原生开辟了一条用于对话中规划和工具调用的通道，使 agentic 行为不再被绑在轮次边界或外部级联上。这正是本站“晚注入工具清单”痛点的正面回应：可借鉴其在流式生成中途插入工具调用而不打断听说的设计。

items.title: SoulX-Duplug: Plug-and-Play Streaming State Prediction Module for Realtime Full-Duplex Speech Conversation
items.summary_en: Recent advances in spoken dialogue systems have brought increased attention to human-like full-duplex voice interactions. However, our comprehensive review of this field reveals several challenges, including the difficulty in obtaining training data, catastrophic forgetting, and limited scalability. In this work, we propose SoulX-Duplug, a plug-and-play streaming state prediction module for full-duplex spoken dialogu
items.summary_zh: SoulX-Duplug 是一个即插即用的流式状态预测模块，为现有语音对话系统补齐全双工能力，同时规避了训练数据难获取、灾难性遗忘和可扩展性差的问题。其“不重训主干、外挂模块实现双工”的路线与本站自研 harness 的哲学高度一致，值得重点跟进。

items.title: Why is nobody using this? Full-duplex voice streaming with Gemini Live in React
items.summary_en:
I built a React hook for real-time voice conversations with Google's Gemini Live API and I'm confused why more people aren't doing this.

Gemini Live is capable - full-duplex audio (interrupt the AI mid-sentence), screen sharing so the AI sees what you're looking at, tool calling, built-in VAD. But using it from a browser is painful:

- Browser audio is 48kHz, Gemini wants 16kHz in and sends 24k
items.summary_zh: 这是一篇工程向分享：作者封装了调用 Gemini Live API 的 React hook，实现可打断的全双工语音对话，并吐槽浏览器侧音频工程之坑（48kHz 重采样到 16kHz 入/24kHz 出、内置 VAD、屏幕共享、工具调用）。对本站座舱 harness 的客户端/音频链路有直接参考价值，尤其是重采样与打断处理的实战细节。

items.title: Enabling Conversational Behavior Reasoning Capabilities in Full-Duplex Speech
items.summary_en: Human conversation is organized by an implicit chain of thoughts that manifests as timed speech acts. Capturing this causal pathway is key to building natural full-duplex interactive systems. We introduce a framework that enables reasoning over conversational behaviors by modeling this process as causal inference within a Graph-of-Thoughts (GoT). Our approach formalizes the intent-to-action pathway with a hierarchica
items.summary_zh: 该工作每秒预测高低层 speech act，并把增量转写与行为节点组成 Graph-of-Thoughts 来生成可解释理由；它本身不是回复或语音生成模型。标签体系可作为 StreamingModelHarness 的流式旁路感知器，但结果存在人评数字冲突、未来信息消融和实现未发布等风险。

items.title: SuperdeMan/cockpit-agent
items.summary_en: 面向智能座舱的云边协同 AI Agent：端侧毫秒级车控，云端声明式 Multi-Agent 与 Skill/DAG 编排，支持 S2S 实时语音、声纹多用户、视觉与 HMI；LLM 只负责理解与规划，VAL 负责确定性安全执行。 agent-orchestration automotive-ai cloud-edge cockpit-agent edge-ai grpc hmi in-vehicle-infotainment intelligent-cockpit large-language-models llm-agent microservices model-context-protocol multi-agent multimodal-ai observability semantic-memory speech-to-speech vehicle-control voice-assistant
items.summary_zh: 一个面向智能座舱的云边协同 AI Agent 开源项目：端侧负责毫秒级车控，云端做声明式 Multi-Agent 与 Skill/DAG 编排，支持 S2S 实时语音、声纹多用户、视觉与 HMI。其'LLM 只管理解与规划、VAL 负责确定性安全执行'的分层思路，与本站 harness 的架构理念高度同构，可作为座舱语音助手工程化（尤其车控安全边界与云边分工）的直接参照。

items.title: TurnNat: Automatic Evaluation of Turn-Taking Naturalness in Dyadic Spoken Dialogue
items.summary_en: Turn-taking naturalness is central to full-duplex spoken dialogue systems, yet its automatic evaluation remains limited. Existing evaluations often rely on human judgments or behavior-specific timing metrics, making it difficult to compare heterogeneous timing failures within a unified framework. We propose TurnNat, a likelihood-based framework for automatic turn-taking naturalness evaluation in two-channel spoken di
items.summary_zh: TurnNat 提出一个基于似然（likelihood）的框架，用于自动评估双通道口语对话中轮换（turn-taking）的自然度，把原本依赖人工判断或单一计时指标的异质时序失败统一到一个可比较的体系里。对本站的全双工座舱助手而言，它补上了'边说边听'体验难量化的一环，可用来自动评测抢话、响应延迟、打断时机等关键指标。

items.title: How Should LLMs Listen While Speaking? A Study of User-Stream Routing in Full-Duplex Spoken Dialogue
items.summary_en: Full-duplex spoken dialogue requires a model to keep listening while generating its own spoken response. This is challenging for large language models (LLMs), which are designed to extend a single coherent sequence and do not naturally support user input arriving during generation. We argue that how the user stream is routed into the LLM is therefore a key architectural question for full-duplex modeling. To study thi
items.summary_zh: 论文比较把用户流直接融合进生成序列的 CF-Duplex 与独立 cross-attention memory 的 XA-Duplex：前者问答和打断更强，后者在漏停时更能隔离重叠输入污染。该权衡只在生成期间持续接收用户流时成立，当前判停后生成的 Harness 不会以同样方式遇到它。

items.title: EchoChain: A Full-Duplex Benchmark for State-Update Reasoning Under Interruptions
items.summary_en: Real-time voice assistants must revise task state when users interrupt mid-response, but existing spoken-dialog benchmarks largely evaluate turn-based interaction and miss this failure mode. We introduce EchoChain, a controlled benchmark for evaluating full-duplex state-update reasoning under mid-speech interruptions. EchoChain identifies three recurring failure patterns in post-interruption continuations: contextual
items.summary_zh: EchoChain 是一个受控基准，专门评估全双工语音助手在用户中途打断后能否正确更新任务状态并继续对话，并归纳出打断后续回复中的三类典型失败模式。它命中现有轮次式评测覆盖不到的盲区，可作为本站座舱助手打断恢复（barge-in 后状态修正）能力的回归测试与选型依据。

items.title: LMPAN: A Lightweight Multi-Path Alignment Network for Joint Full-Duplex Acoustic Echo Cancellation and Noise Suppression
items.summary_en: We propose a lightweight multi-path alignment network (LMPAN) for on-device joint acoustic echo cancellation (AEC) and noise suppression (NS) in full-duplex spoken dialogue systems. To address hardware-induced distortions and dynamic acoustic conditions, we introduce three core innovations: (1) a multi-path alignment stage correcting temporal and energy mismatches across reference, linear AEC (LAEC) output, and micro
items.summary_zh: LMPAN 用三路软时延/能量对齐、双 GTCRN 和动态目标联合做 AEC 与降噪；强回声区 WER 从 24.25% 降到 14.38%，真实打断率从 85.17% 升到 93.85%。它可放在 Harness 判停前并使用外挂 TTS 播放 reference，但论文未给设备端 RTF、延迟和功耗。

items.title: A Survey of Full-Duplex Spoken Dialogue Systems: Architectural Hierarchy, Interaction Ontology, and Decision State Machine
items.summary_en: More than a dozen spoken dialogue systems have recently claimed to be "full-duplex," yet the term has been used to describe substantially different capabilities. Existing surveys collapse them onto a single axis (cascaded/end-to-end, or engineered/learned) and miss the distinctions that matter most for builders. We argue that much of this ambiguity is taxonomical: current terminology does not specify where duplex dec
items.summary_zh: 该综述用 L0–L3 决策层级、210 个 T×I×R 名义交互单元和五状态机拆解“全双工”，并指出已审计系统中尚无实现 L3 shared latent。按其口径，StreamingModelHarness 仍是流式输入、endpoint 后生成的 L0-shaped pipeline，应分开报告判停、工具、TTS 首包与取消延迟。

items.title: Nvidia PersonaPlex 7B on Apple Silicon: Full-Duplex Speech-to-Speech in Swift
items.summary_zh: 这条新闻报道了 NVIDIA 的全双工语音到语音模型 PersonaPlex 7B 被移植到 Apple Silicon 上、以 Swift 实现本地运行。它与本站主题的相关性在于展示了大参数全双工 S2S 模型的端侧部署路径，对座舱这种讲究离线可用与低时延的场景有参考价值；但仅有标题信息，具体实现细节与效果需进一步求证。

items.title: VideoFDB: Evaluating Full-Duplex Vision-Speech Capabilities in Conversational Agents
items.summary_en: Natural human conversation is full-duplex and audio-visual: people simultaneously speak and listen while continuously interpreting and producing nonverbal cues, such as nods, smiles, and gestures. To support successful human-agent interaction, agents must model full-duplex audiovisual conversation; however, existing full-duplex benchmarks evaluate only speech. In this work, we present VideoFDB, the first benchmark to
items.summary_zh: VideoFDB 以 237 个评测行、11 类视频对话动态测试凝视、表情、动作和语音的联合感知/生成；最佳非人类 AV2A Overall 为 3.40，人类为 4.20。Harness 可借 TOR-Alignment 测系统级让权和反馈时机，但 endpoint 后生成与外挂 TTS 无法满足用户话轮内的原生视听全双工。

items.title: RelayS2S: A Dual-Path Speculative Generation for Real-Time Dialogue
items.summary_en: Real-time spoken dialogue systems face a fundamental tension between latency and response quality. End-to-end speech-to-speech (S2S) models respond immediately and naturally handle turn-taking, backchanneling, and interruption, but produce semantically weaker outputs. Cascaded pipelines (ASR -> LLM) deliver stronger responses at the cost of latency that grows with model size. We present RelayS2S, a hybrid architectur
items.summary_zh: RelayS2S 让小型双工模型先给出经 verifier 审核的约 5 词前缀，再由强 LLM 续写；GPT-4o 后端 P90 为 81ms、级联为 1,091ms，但该口径不含判停、网络和 TTS。Harness 可在 endpoint 后借鉴双路生成，但晚注入工具前不应抢先承诺事实内容。

items.title: Sympatheia: Emotionally Adaptive Voice Assistant with Continuous Affect Conditioning
items.summary_en: Empathetic spoken dialogue systems must infer a user's emotional state to respond appropriately, yet everyday speech often carries weak, neutral, or ambiguous affective cues. To address this, we introduce Sympatheia, a speech-to-speech dialogue framework conditioned on affect inferred from the user's speech and, when available, explicit affect specifications provided as a continuous valence--arousal (VA) control sign
items.summary_zh: Sympatheia 在 GLM-4-Voice-9B 上用连续 valence–arousal 条件控制内容与原生语音，显式 VA 将 Neutral 分数从 1.883 提升到 4.368。Harness 可在首 token 前注入 VA，但外挂 TTS 也必须支持相同风格控制，否则只能保留内容层适配，不能外推论文的韵律收益。

items.title: DyaPlex: Full-Duplex Speech-Motion Model for Dyadic Interaction
items.summary_en: We present DyaPlex, a streaming, full-duplex speech-and-motion model designed for dyadic interaction. To capture the continuous and reciprocal nature of human communication, this full-duplex capability empowers the agent to simultaneously perceive and generate both speech and physical motion in a streaming fashion. At its core, our method leverages the strong priors of a foundational full-duplex speech model and inte
items.summary_zh: DyaPlex 是一个流式全双工的'语音+动作'模型，面向双人交互，能在流式模式下同时感知与生成语音和身体动作，做法上复用了基础全双工语音模型的先验并扩展出动作通道。动作生成对纯座舱语音助手相关性有限，胜在其架构思路——在一个基础全双工语音模型上叠加新的流式输出模态——与我们想在 Omni 模型外挂 TTS/工具通道的 harness 设计异曲同工。

items.title: OmniInteract: Benchmarking Real-World Streaming Interaction for Real-Time Omnimodal Assistants
items.summary_en: We introduce OmniInteract, a streaming benchmark for real-time omnimodal large language models evaluated through native online inference over audio-visual streams. Unlike offline video understanding or text-prompted streaming QA, OmniInteract preserves the original audio-visual stream and requires models to process it online, without access to future content. User queries and ambient sounds are embedded in the audio
items.summary_zh: OmniInteract 用 250 个视频、1,430 个带时限 slot 联合评测实时回答、主动响应、中断与嵌套恢复，最佳总 IA-QTF1 仅 0.368。它的 slot 协议适合 StreamingModelHarness，但 endpoint 后生成只能覆盖部分任务，外挂 TTS 与晚注入工具应另计系统级时序。

items.title: S-MARC: Causal Streaming Reasoning for Full-Duplex Conversational Behavior Modeling
items.summary_en: Human conversation is organized by an implicit chain of thought and manifests as temporally structured conversational behaviors. Capturing this perceptual pathway is critical for building natural full-duplex interactive systems. We propose S-MARC (Streaming Causal Modeling and Reasoning for Conversation), a streaming, causal, and hierarchical framework for conversational behavior modeling and reasoning. By formalizin
items.summary_zh: S-MARC 每秒融合流式 ASR 和声学特征，预测对话行为并从 90 秒因果图生成证据化理由；单 A6000 的 input-to-rationale p95 为 1.0491 秒。它可作为 Harness 的 endpoint/打断 sidecar 设计参考，但不是回复生成器，且实现、权重和 ConversationGoT-120h 均未公开。

items.title: Ruiqi-Yan/Awesome-Full-Duplex-SDM
items.summary_en: A curated list of full-duplex spoken dialogue models & benchmarks awesome-list full-duplex spoken-dialogue-models spoken-dialogue-systems
items.summary_zh: 一份精选全双工口语对话模型与基准测试的 awesome 清单，持续收录该方向的模型、系统和评测资源。对座舱助手项目是实用的导航页：选型基线模型、寻找全双工能力评测基准（如打断、抢话、延迟指标）时可以按图索骥，避免重复调研。

items.title: Show HN: Audio AI had a wild day – 5 major open-source / real-time TTS drops
items.summary_en:
The audio/TTS space just moved fast. In the last week alone:

NVIDIA – PersonaPlex-7B Open-source, full-duplex conversational speech model.

Inworld AI – TTS-1.5 Realtime TTS (<250ms), $0.005/min, currently #1 on Artificial Analysis.

Flash Labs – Chroma 1.0 First open-source, end-to-end, real-time speech-to-speech model.

Alibaba Qwen – Qwen3-TTS Fully open-sourced TTS family: Base, CustomVoice, Voi
items.summary_zh: 一则 HN 热帖，汇总了近期音频/TTS 领域的密集发布：NVIDIA 开源全双工对话语音模型 PersonaPlex-7B、Inworld 延迟低于 250ms 的实时 TTS-1.5、Flash Labs 首个开源端到端实时 speech-to-speech 模型 Chroma 1.0，以及阿里全面开源的 Qwen3-TTS 家族。对本站价值直接：外挂 TTS 环节多了一批低延迟可自托管候选（尤其 Qwen3-TTS 与 Qwen3-Omni 同栈），PersonaPlex 和 Chroma 则可作为全双工架构的对标参照。

items.title: xcc-zach/xtalk
items.summary_en: X-Talk is an open-source full-duplex cascaded spoken dialogue system framework enabling low-latency, interruptible, and human-like speech interaction with a lightweight, pure-Python, production-ready architecture. ai conversational-ai python real-time speech-to-speech voice voice-assistant websocket
items.summary_zh: X-Talk 是一个开源的全双处级联式口语对话系统框架，纯 Python、轻量、面向生产，主打低延迟、可打断、拟人化的语音交互，基于 WebSocket 提供服务。与自研 harness 路线高度同构：其级联流水线中打断处理、状态管理与流式调度的工程实现可作为直接参考，也可用作对照基线来验证自研全双工方案的延迟与打断体验。

items.title: akirilyuk/node-webrtc-rust
items.summary_en: Rust-native voice agents for Node.js — WebRTC, VAD, barge-in, and speech events. Free on-device STT+TTS via Sherpa-ONNX; cloud vendors optional. Your LLM stays in TypeScript. local-ai local-first local-stt local-tts node nodejs privacy-first real-time realtime rust sherpa-onnx speech-to-text text-to-speech voice-agent webrtc
items.summary_zh: 一个用 Rust 为 Node.js 提供原生语音智能体能力的库，内置 WebRTC、VAD、barge-in(打断)和语音事件，并通过 Sherpa-ONNX 提供免费的端侧 STT/TTS，LLM 逻辑留在 TypeScript 侧。对座舱助手很有参考价值：打断检测与 VAD 是全双工"边说边听"的关键痛点，端侧 STT/TTS 契合车内低延迟与隐私需求，其"推理引擎与 LLM 解耦"的分层也与自研 harness + 外挂 TTS 的架构思路一致。

items.title: What does full duplex (voice) actually mean?
items.summary_zh: 一篇厘清"全双工语音到底意味着什么"的概念性文章。对建站有基础价值：在为 Qwen3-Omni + harness 方案设定目标时，需要明确什么才算真正的全双工（同时听说、可打断、轮替自然），以便界定评测口径与架构差距；摘要缺失，具体内容保守看待。

items.title: PersonaPlex-7B: full-duplex voice model that listens and talks at the same time
items.summary_zh: PersonaPlex-7B，一个能同时听和说的端到端全双工语音模型。它是自研 harness 路线的直接对照物：可以用它对比"模型原生全双工"与"harness 编排流式 KV + 外挂 TTS"两种方案在自然度、可控性和工具接入上的取舍。

items.title: Hertz-dev is an open-source model for full-duplex conversational audio
items.summary_zh: Hertz-dev，一个开源的全双工会话音频模型。作为开源基线，可用于对比座舱方案中"端到端音频建模"与"多模态模型 + 自研 harness"的差异，并为流式音频的延迟与轮替指标提供参照。

items.title: Why speech-to-speech is the future for AI voice agents: Unpacking the AIEWF Eval
items.summary_zh: 一篇解读 AIEWF Eval 的文章，论证为什么 speech-to-speech 是 AI 语音智能体的未来。对本站的取舍讨论直接相关：它有助于评估"harness + 外挂 TTS 的级联路线"相对"端到端语音到语音"在延迟、情感和打断处理上的优劣，其评测方法也可借鉴用于座舱助手的对比测试。

items.title: Show HN: Jargo, a Go port of Pipecat for building realtime voice agents
items.summary_zh: Jargo，把实时语音智能体框架 Pipecat 移植到 Go 的项目。对本站的 harness 工程化有参考意义：可以借鉴其管线编排、音频流处理与打断管理的设计，Go 实现也提示了车载部署时对并发性能与资源占用的考量。

items.title: DuplexGen: Adaptive Synthesis of Human-AI Turn-Taking Dialogues
items.summary_en: Turn-taking is a central component of full-duplex interaction. Which turn-taking behaviors are appropriate varies with the scenario, yet current models apply a single norm regardless of context. This limitation originates in their training data: human-human speech corpora capture natural timing phenomena but provide little role grounding or scenario-specific norms, while heuristic or prompted synthesis methods inject
items.summary_zh: DuplexGen 用 slot 级人类偏好校准 Qwen3，再按六类场景合成 BACKCHANNEL/TAKE_FLOOR 数据；SWBD+DuplexGen 的平均 KL 为 0.335，prompt-only 为 0.458。其标签和场景差异适合做 Harness 离线回归，但 endpoint 后生成无法直接执行话中附和或抢话。

items.title: FacePlex: Full-Duplex Joint Speech-Facial Motion Generation for Conversational Avatars
items.summary_en: Natural face-to-face conversation requires real-time speech generation together with synchronized facial motion. Existing systems only partially address this problem: speech-only full-duplex models can generate speech in real time but do not produce facial motion, while audio-driven facial motion models animate a face from already available audio rather than jointly generating speech and motion online. To bridge this
items.summary_zh: FacePlex 以 PersonaPlex 为主干，每 80ms 联合输出语音块和两个 FLAME 面部帧，25 人研究的总体 MOS 为 3.736。它依赖内部隐藏状态与待播放预测语音，当前 endpoint 后生成、外挂 TTS 的 Harness 只能做普通 audio-driven animation，无法复现联合全双工。

items.title: Wan-Streamer v0.1: End-to-end Real-time Interactive Foundation Models
items.summary_en: We present Wan-Streamer, a native-streaming, end-to-end interactive foundation model designed from the ground up for real-time, low-latency, full-duplex audio-visual interaction. Wan-Streamer seamlessly models language, audio, and video as both input and output within a single Transformer, where the sequence is represented as interleaved visual, audio, and text input tokens together with visual, audio, and text outpu
items.summary_zh: Wan-Streamer v0.1 在单个 Transformer 中因果交错文本、音频和视频输入输出，160ms 一步、模型侧 signal-to-signal 约 200ms，但只验证了 192p 且未报告标准质量指标。它是 StreamingModelHarness 的长期原生流式对标，不是可接入后端：代码、权重和数据均未发布。

items.title: AV-Dialog: Spoken Dialogue Models with Audio-Visual Input
items.summary_en: Dialogue models falter in noisy, multi-speaker environments, often producing irrelevant responses and awkward turn-taking. We present AV-Dialog, the first multimodal dialog framework that uses both audio and visual cues to track the target speaker, predict turn-taking, and generate coherent responses. By combining acoustic tokenization with multi-task, multi-stage training on monadic, synthetic, and real audio-visual
items.summary_zh: AV-Dialog 每 40ms 融合 DAC 音频 token 和唇部视觉特征，在多人噪声下流式跟踪目标说话者并预测 turn-event；干扰条件 A+V WER 为 38.8%，Auto-AVSR 为 71.8%。dual 版的外挂 TTS 与 Harness 有交集，但它能在回复中持续监听和让权，不能被 endpoint 后生成架构直接等同。

items.title: AnovaX: A Local, Multi-Agent Voice Assistant with LLM Planning, Typed Executors, and Adaptive Recovery
items.summary_en: Desktop voice assistants are still dominated by cloud pipelines that ship raw audio off the machine and expose a fixed set of skills. We describe AnovaX, a small local-first assistant that runs entirely on the user's computer and treats the desktop itself as its action surface. A single Python process wires together a wake-word gate, a speech pipeline, an LLM planner (Gemini) that emits a JSON plan of tool calls, a w
items.summary_zh: AnovaX 用 JSON 规划、白名单安全检查、类型化执行器、资源锁和有界恢复编排桌面语音任务，但只做单机手工定性验证。其工具调度可借给 Harness 的晚注入执行层；默认仍依赖 Google ASR、Gemini 和外挂 TTS，且没有模型级全双工。

items.title: Omni-Prune: Query-Aware Unified Token Pruning for Efficient Omnimodal Large Language Models
items.summary_en: Omnimodal large language models (OmniLLMs) are rapidly extending multimodal reasoning to cover synchronized audio and video. However, the resulting audio-video token sequences are long, leading to high prefill latency and GPU memory usage at inference time. Existing token pruning methods, designed mainly for vision-only inputs, miss both the cross-modal links between audio and video and the user query that decides wh
items.summary_zh: Omni-Prune 按音频事件分窗，并用显著性、查询相关性、音视配对和多样性代表免训练剪枝；7B 在 35% 保留率下保持 99.0% 归一化表现，prefill 由 899ms 降至 277ms。它适合 Harness 判停后的完整输入 prefill，不加速判停前流式阶段，也不处理外挂 TTS。

items.title: Spatial-Omni: Spatial Audio Understanding Integration in Multimodal LLMs via FOA Encoding
items.summary_en: Recent multimodal large language models mainly process audio as monaural signals, thereby discarding the spatial cues contained in spatial audio for sound localization, spatial relation reasoning, and spatial scene understanding. We propose Spatial-Omni, a lightweight method that implements SO-Encoder to inject First-Order Ambisonics (FOA) spatial audio into existing Omni LLMs as an independent modality, without modi
items.summary_zh: Spatial-Omni 保留单声道语义路径并增加 FOA 空间编码器，使 Omni LLM 获得方向、距离、运动和多声源关系理解，SO-7B(MIX) 方位角准确率为 71.79%。它适合补充座舱席位感知，但只按最长 20 秒片段评测，不证明流式判停或模型级全双工。

items.title: Hierarchical Acoustic-Semantic Modeling: Modality Separation and Semantic Coherence for Full-Duplex SLMs
items.summary_en: Developing seamless, high-performance, native intelligent full-duplex Spoken Language Models (SLMs) remains a critical challenge and long-standing goal for the speech and NLP community. Despite notable progress, recent endeavors are fundamentally constrained by severe modality interference, which causes substantial knowledge degradation and compromises semantic integrity -- ultimately making full-duplex SLMs feel unn
items.summary_zh: Lychee-FD 用浅层共享、深层语义/声学/控制分头和连续语义对齐缓解全双工训练冲突，在 FullDuplexBench 1.5 上报告 570ms 打断停止和 826ms 响应延迟。它是可替换的原生全双工后端而非 Harness 局部插件，且训练数据开放状态仍未知。

items.title: Metronome: Bound the Cache, Keep the Beat for Real-Time Interaction Model Serving
items.summary_en: Real-time interaction models -- Moshi, MiniCPM-o, Qwen-Omni -- turn serving into a periodic real-time task: on every frame a session ingests streaming audio and must respond by a recurring wall-clock deadline, while its KV cache grows monotonically and stays pinned for the whole conversation. This regime hides a dangerous failure mode. On a real full-duplex stack, sustained load does not degrade serving gracefully: i
items.summary_zh: Metronome 用有界滑窗 KV、attention sinks 和 AIMD 准入控制防止长期实时会话突然耗尽缓存；5 分钟测试把无界 KV 的 14/20 次崩溃降为 0/20。当前 Harness 判停后才生成，主要应借鉴长会话上限、活性监控和分钟级压力测试，而非直接套用 209 会话容量。

items.title: Overcoming State Inertia in Full-Duplex Spoken Language Models via Activation Steering
items.summary_en: Full-duplex spoken language models (FD-SLMs) enable seamless speech interaction by allowing models to listen and speak simultaneously, yet the internal mechanism by which they coordinate listening and speaking remains underexplored. We analyze the predictive behavior encoded in FD-SLM hidden representations and find that they exhibit stream-specific predictive patterns: during listening, they preferentially predict t
items.summary_zh: 该文把全双工模型漏听打断首词归因于生成态向感知态切换滞后，并用短时隐藏向量注入将 PersonaPlex 的打断正确率由 0.28 提升至 0.45。当前 Harness 不暴露这类模型中间层，短期更适合借用其首词敏感 ZBB 做系统回归。

items.title: FastTurn: Unifying Acoustic and Streaming Semantic Cues for Low-Latency and Robust Turn Detection
items.summary_en: Recent advances in AudioLLMs have enabled spoken dialogue systems to move beyond turn-based interaction toward real-time full-duplex communication, where the agent must decide when to speak, yield, or interrupt while the user is still talking. Existing full-duplex approaches either rely on voice activity cues, which lack semantic understanding, or on ASR-based modules, which introduce latency and degrade under overla
items.summary_zh: FastTurn 融合 streaming CTC、Conformer 声学表示和 Qwen3-0.6B，判断 Complete、Incomplete、Backchannel、Wait，在自建集上为 79.62% accuracy、120.1ms 平均延迟。它与 Harness 生成前判停最匹配，但没有代码和权重，延迟定义与数据许可链也需先核验。

items.title: Harness TTS: Towards Context-Aware Expressive Speech Synthesis with Harness Layer
items.summary_en: Expressive speech synthesis for voice assistants requires flexible style control that adapts to explicit requests and broader interaction context. We propose Harness TTS, a lightweight control layer that wraps around a TTS engine to externalize and govern its expressive behavior. It reformulates style control as closed-set prompt-tool routing: offline, a compact registry of stylistic prompt tools is constructed with
items.summary_zh: Harness TTS 把多源上下文路由成有限、可审计的提示音频，再驱动现有 CosyVoice3 或 VoxCPM2；无 CoT 的 First-ID P95 为 41.2ms。它与 Harness 的外挂 TTS 形态直接同构，但不改变判停后生成，且目前没有官方代码、权重或数据。

items.title: AVSCap: Orchestrating Audio-Visual Synergy for Omni-modal Video Captioning
items.summary_en: Omni-modal video captioning is not merely combining visual captioning with audio transcription: a useful caption must describe how visual actions, speech, music, and sound effects co-evolve. Existing large multimodal models often fail at this relational step, treating audio and visual streams as loosely coupled observations, relying on automatic speech recognition, and under-specifying non-speech sounds and their lin
items.summary_zh: AVSCap 显式监督语音、音乐、音效与视觉事件的时间绑定，并以 SFT+GRPO 训练事件级 omni-modal captioner。它可提升 StreamingModelHarness 判停后的音视频描述和离线评测，但不处理并发听说、打断、晚注入工具或外挂 TTS 同步。

items.title: dograh-hq/dograh
items.summary_en: Open source voice AI platform. Self-hosted alternative to Vapi and Retell. On Prem, BYOK across Speech to Speech or LLM/STT/TTS, with a visual workflow builder, MCP native and telephony support. ai-calling asterisk-ari conversational-ai inbound-calls local-llm no-code on-prem-voice-agent-platform open-source open-source-voice-ai outbound-calls pipecat python self-hosted speech-to-speech speech-to-text telephony text-
items.summary_zh: 一篇全模态视频字幕论文，指出好的全模态描述不只是视觉字幕加语音转写，而要刻画视觉动作、语音、音乐、音效如何协同演化，并批评现有大模型把音视流当作松耦合观察。对座舱场景有参考价值：助手需要把驾驶员语音与车内视觉流做关系性理解而非各自独立处理，其音视协同编排思路可用于改进多模态对齐。

items.title: VideoFDB: Evaluating Full-Duplex Vision-Speech Capabilities in Agents
items.summary_zh: 开源自托管语音AI平台（对标Vapi/Retell），支持Speech-to-Speech或LLM/STT/TTS链路、BYOK、可视化工作流编排、原生MCP与电话接入。虽然面向电话外呼/呼入而非座舱，但其流水线编排与MCP原生工具接入可作为本站harness晚注入工具清单、语音链路架构的工程参照。

items.title: Show HN: Τ³-Bench is out – can agents handle complex docs and live calls?
items.summary_en:
τ-Bench is an open benchmark for evaluating AI agents on grounded, multi-turn customer service tasks with verifiable outcomes. It's been great to see the community adopt it since launch — this is now the third iteration. With τ³-Bench, we're extending it to two new settings: knowledge-intensive retrieval and full-duplex voice.

τ-Knowledge: agents must navigate ~700 interconnected policy documents to compl
items.summary_zh: τ-Bench的第三代开源基准发布，在原有可验证结果的多轮客服任务之外，新增两个场景：约700篇互相关联政策文档的知识密集型检索，以及全双工语音。对本站而言它是少见的把全双工语音纳入Agent评测的公开基准，可用来检验座舱助手在实时打断、多轮工具调用下的表现。

items.title: Show HN: Production duplex speech model for revenue calls
items.summary_en:
Hi, HN, we’re building Mia & Leo: AI personalities backed by purpose-built duplex speech models for revenue calls.

Teams building real-world agents told us that more than 40% of callers hang up within the first 30 seconds. On a revenue call, that meant a lost booking, an unpaid balance, a cold lead, or a customer who does not come back.

This happens because humans interrupt, correct dates, pause halfway throu
items.summary_zh: 从标题看是一个面向Agent的全双工'视觉+语音'能力评测基准(VideoFDB)。与本站主题几乎正中靶心——全双工座舱助手正是视觉语音双流的Agent，可作为能力评估与回归测试的候选基准；但目前仅有标题信息，具体任务设计与指标待原文确认。
